description: A deep interest in science and assistance in future space operations.
summary: We have developed a fire emergency system for spaceship safety. We used a NASA data and took information about how fire behaves in microgravity conditions for program references values. If we want to explore space in future it is significant to provide safety in emergency situations that potentially could disrupt a mission.
details:
Benefits and Intended Impact

The main benefit of our project is improving astronaut safety by detecting potential fire hazards at an early stage. It reduces the time needed to identify an emergency and allows the crew and mission control on Earth to respond more quickly. Our intended impact is to make future space missions safer and more reliable.

Technology Stack and Development Tools

Our project was developed using TypeScript and React for the frontend, Python and Flask for the backend, and SQLite for database management.

For artificial intelligence, we implemented our own machine learning model based on Softmax Regression, as well as an AI integration layer supporting multiple providers. We also developed a computer vision system for analyzing fire characteristics in images.

The application uses real-time data processing, mathematical fire behavior modeling, and automated report generation. We used GitHub Actions for continuous integration and deployment, with GitHub Pages hosting the frontend and a cloud-based tunnel connecting it to the backend.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of our project lies in combining real-time monitoring, artificial intelligence, and automated emergency reporting in a single system. Unlike basic fire detection systems, our program does not simply detect smoke or high temperatures: it also analyzes video footage, identifies the location and possible cause of an incident, and generates detailed reports.

Factors Considered

Our team considered several important factors, including temperature changes, airflow, the flammability of different materials, the location of potential hazards, and the limited time available to respond to emergencies in space. We also considered the importance of reliable communication between the spacecraft and Earth.
